props.name: disabled
props._description: Greys the control out and blocks all interaction — it cannot be focused, clicked or edited. It still occupies its grid slot.

props.name: readOnly
props._description: Keeps the value visible and selectable but not editable. Unlike `disabled`, normal styling is retained.

props.name: pin
props._description: Corner shape, written as `left-right`: `round-round` fully rounded, `brick-brick` square, `clear-clear` no visible edge.

props.name: view
props._description: `normal` draws the usual bordered field; `clear` removes the border and background.

props.name: placeholder
props._description: Grey hint text shown while the field is empty.

props.name: leftContent
props._description: Fixed text or symbol pinned inside the left edge of the field, such as a unit or currency prefix.

props.name: rightContent
props._description: Fixed text or symbol pinned inside the right edge of the field, such as a unit suffix.

props.name: enableHeaderText

content.name: Header Text
content._description: The caption text shown beside the control.

position.name: Header Position
position._description: Which side of the control the caption sits on: `left`, `top`, `right` or `bottom`.

props._description: Turns on a caption attached to the control. When true, the `_true` sub-props supply the caption text and which side it sits on.

props.name: numberFormat
props._description: Digit grouping applied to numeric input: `Indian` (1,00,000), `International` (100,000), `European` (100.000), or `none`. Disabled in the source default — switch `enabled` to true to use it.

props.name: isCurrency
props._description: Formats and stores the value as a currency amount.

props.name: bindInitialData
props._description: Pre-fills the field from bound data when the screen loads rather than starting empty.
